description: Call a method on a node in the running game (e.g. a test hook such as restart() or spawn_wave(3)) and return its result. Arguments are converted to the declared parameter types; coroutines are awaited.

node.description: Node in the running game: relative to the running scene (e.g. 'Player') or absolute (e.g. '/root/Main/Player'). Default: the running scene root.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the result. Default 10000.

name: game_call
title: Call method in running game
